title: Special Executive Programme In Procurement Risk And Contract Management
description: This programme focuses on effective procurement risk and contract management in project environments.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Procurement Risk and Contract Management provides a comprehensive understanding of e-procurement, contract lifecycle management, and risk mitigation strategies. Participants will explore both theoretical and practical aspects of procurement in project management.
courseDetails: The project procurement management and its process. The procurement methods and cycle. The meaning and stages of contract management. The spend analysis and rebate management. The meaning and benefits of the evergreen contract. - The meaning and components of procurement legal framework. - The various examples of legal framework requirements. - The meaning and types of public procurement directives. The tender process and its evaluation. The concept of procurement risk and its various types. The meaning of e-procurement risks, its causes and types. Risk probability framework, risk scoring, and risk impact ranges. You will also learn about the procurement risk cycle. Participants will delve into e-procurement systems, including ERP, e-sourcing, and e-tendering, while learning category management and procurement instruments. The course covers the full procurement cycle, from contract management to legislative frameworks and tender processes. Emphasis will be placed on procurement risk types, their causes, and mitigation strategies through a risk probability framework. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following, E-procurement in Project management: Procurement and Contract Management: Project procurement legislative framework: Project procurement Risk Management:
